nodes.label: Responsible vulnerability disclosure process
nodes.rationale: Security issues must be reported privately via security@prismio.org, not public GitHub issues. Target timeline: acknowledge within 48 hours, initial assessment within 7 days. Disclosure should stay private until verified, fixed, and coordinated.

nodes.label: Security policy scope
nodes.rationale: Covers the Prismio compiler, runtime library, LLVM bridge layer, package/build tooling, and official Prismio infrastructure/repositories; third-party/LLVM vulnerabilities go to their own maintainers.
